question: Should this durable runtime implementation proceed before https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101828 is merged or declared canonical?
rationale: The PR introduces core runtime, gateway, CLI, schema, and config surfaces on top of an open architecture PR that still carries maintainer-direction risk.

options.title: Pause Until RFC Is Canonical
options.body: Resolve or merge the RFC PR first, then rebase this implementation against that accepted boundary.

options.title: Make This The Canonical Stack
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly treat this PR as the implementation vehicle and use it to supersede or fold the separate RFC thread.

recommendation.title: Pause Until RFC Is Canonical
recommendation.body: Resolve or merge the RFC PR first, then rebase this implementation against that accepted boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest available routing candidate from recent gateway/runtime history and prior durable RFC review routing.
